QuestInfo.name: South Sanctum Patrol
QuestInfo.0: Angelic Buster? What kind of person is she? In any event, you're done with the North Sanctum.
QuestInfo.2: Fortunately, nothing happened at #m400030000#. You explained the situation to #p3000005#.

0.0: The Nefarious Priests could attack the other sanctums at any time. We need to let the priests at each one know about this.

yes.0: Since Angelic Buster will scout the North Sanctum, you head to the South Sanctum and tell them there could be an attack. Christina is at the South Sanctum.

no.0: Well, if you think you have more important things to do, I'll just wait. I...can't think of what else I could do now...

1.0: #h0#, what are you doing here? Did you come to see me?

yes.0: Oh, we might be attacked. Gee, you know just what a girl likes to hear. You know I don't like fighting. Wait...does that mean you're going to stay and help? Because I like that plan.
